description: Single-panel line plot (one image, no lettered sub-panels) showing the strain-hardening analysis of Fe-12Mn-8Al-0.8C steel. The abscissa is labelled "lnσ, MPa" with ticks every 0.1 from 6.5 to 7.3; the ordinate is labelled "Ln(dσ/dε), MPa" with labelled ticks at 6.5, 7.0, 7.5, 8.0 and 8.5. About fifteen square data markers joined by a solid black line trace the curve, which printed annotations divide into three regimes. "Stage 1" falls steeply from just above 8.5 at lnσ≈6.58 down to about 7.75 near lnσ≈6.62; the boundary is labelled ε₁=0.05. "Stage 2" occupies most of the abscissa as an almost straight, very gently decreasing segment running from about 7.8 to about 7.3 and ends at the label ε₂=0.30 near lnσ≈7.13. "Stage 3" is an abrupt, near-vertical drop to about 6.65 within a very narrow lnσ interval around 7.15-7.18. No legend is shown; the curve is the only dataset. The figure demonstrates that strain hardening of this A-BDP steel is not monotonic but passes through three distinct stages separated by the critical strains ε₁=0.05 and ε₂=0.30.

subfigures.description: Ln(dσ/dε) versus lnσ plot for Fe-12Mn-8Al-0.8C steel with three annotated stages: Stage 1 steep drop, Stage 2 nearly linear plateau-like decline, Stage 3 abrupt near-vertical drop; critical strains ε₁=0.05 and ε₂=0.30 are printed on the curve. Ordinate 6.5-8.5 (Ln(dσ/dε), MPa), abscissa 6.5-7.3 (lnσ, MPa).

observations.observation: The figure is a single ln(dσ/dε) vs lnσ curve for Fe-12Mn-8Al-0.8C steel; the ordinate 'Ln(dσ/dε), MPa' is scaled 6.5-8.5 and the abscissa 'lnσ, MPa' is scaled 6.5-7.3 with 0.1 spacing.
Three regimes are annotated on the curve in the pixels: 'Stage 1' (leftmost steep descent), 'Stage 2' (long gently decreasing near-straight middle segment), 'Stage 3' (rightmost near-vertical drop).
The Stage 1 to Stage 2 transition is marked by the printed label ε₁=0.05, at a position of about lnσ≈6.62.
The Stage 2 to Stage 3 transition is marked by the printed label ε₂=0.30, at a position of about lnσ≈7.13.
Stage 1 descends from just above the 8.5 ordinate gridline to about 7.75-7.8 within a very narrow lnσ interval (roughly 6.58-6.62).
Stage 2 is an almost straight, slightly decreasing segment running from about 7.8 down to about 7.3 over the lnσ range ≈6.65-7.13.
Stage 3 falls nearly vertically from about 7.3 to about 6.65 within the short lnσ interval ≈7.15-7.18, i.e. within about 0.05 on the abscissa.
Only one dataset is plotted (~15 square markers joined by a solid black line); there is no legend and no second curve.
The caption states the figure gives the ln(dσ/dε) vs lnσ curves of Fe-12Mn-8Al-0.8C steel, showing three stages with different slopes at the critical strains ε₁ and ε₂.
The citation states that the hardness difference between ferrite and austenite in A-BDP steels causes multi-stage strain hardening during tensile deformation (refs. [90,91]).
The citation attributes Stage 1 to single ferrite deformation, producing a sharp decrease in strain hardening rate.
The citation attributes Stage 2 to the onset of austenite deformation, during which the strain hardening curve is approximately a straight line.
The citation attributes Stage 3 to severe strain localization causing a quick drop in strain hardening rate because of the marked hardness difference between ferrite and austenite.

unreadable_items: The caption symbol for the second critical strain is rendered as a garbled glyph ('ε_ε2'); the plot itself prints ε₂=0.30, which is taken as the intended value
No numeric values are printed on the axes beyond the tick labels; data-point ordinate/abscissa values are read by position only
